author: IGUser001
title: 算法推荐太糟糕了
content: The algorithm recommendations are terrible! 我根本不感兴趣的内容一直出现在我的首页。算法推荐完全不考虑我实际关注和点赞的内容。请修复算法逻辑，stop showing me random posts!

author: IGUser002
title: 视觉效果太棒了
content: The visual effects are absolutely amazing! 滤镜种类丰富，照片编辑功能强大，我能做出专业级别的图片。视觉设计一直是 Instagram 的核心优势，perfect for creative people who love sharing beautiful content.

author: IGUser003
title: 还行吧，一般般
content: 还行吧，就是一个普通的社交软件。Not bad but not exceptional either. 功能中规中矩，界面变化不大。整体就是average的体验，没有什么让我特别惊喜的地方。

author: IGUser004
title: Story加载太慢了
content: Stories load so slowly! I have to wait 10 seconds for each story to load. 有时候故事加载到一半就卡住了，特别是视频story。My network is fine, all other apps work fast. Fix the story loading issue please.

author: IGUser005
title: 社交连接做得很好
content: Excellent social connection features! 我通过Instagram认识了很多志同道合的朋友。The ability to connect with creators and brands directly is amazing. 私信功能也很棒，方便和朋友日常互动分享生活点滴。

author: IGUser006
title: 隐私问题令人担忧
content: Major privacy concerns! My DMs keep showing read status even though I turned it off. 隐私设置经常自己重置，有人能看到我在线状态明明设置了隐藏。These privacy bugs are really making me consider deleting my account.

author: IGUser007
title: Reels功能挺有趣的
content: Reels are actually really fun! I love discovering new creators through short videos. 算法推荐有时候还挺准的，能发现我感兴趣的内容。Great for entertainment and learning new things. Easy to use interface too.

author: IGUser008
title: 广告太多了受不了
content: Way too many ads! I see an ad every 4th post and ads in stories too. So many sponsored Reels that I have zero interest in. 广告数量已经超过正常内容了，体验越来越差。Please stop flooding us with ads!

author: IGUser009
title: 滤镜效果超赞
content: The filter effects are incredible! AR filters make stories so much fun. 滤镜种类越来越多，质量也很高，特别适合自拍和风景照。I love how easy it is to transform ordinary photos into beautiful ones with just one tap.

author: IGUser010
title: Story功能有bug
content: Serious story bug! 我发的story有时候根本发不出去，显示发送成功但没人能看到。Sometimes when I reply to stories the message goes missing. 还有点赞数显示错误。这些story bug太影响使用了！

author: IGUser011
title: 普通的社交应用
content: 普通的社交应用吧，能用就行。Normal features for photo sharing. Nothing particularly outstanding but nothing terrible either. 用了很多年已经习惯了，就是average experience。

author: IGUser012
title: Reels算法推荐差
content: Reels algorithm is broken! I keep getting the same 10 creators over and over. 如果我点赞了一个宠物视频，接下来全是宠物相关的。The algorithm recommendations have no variety at all. 推荐系统需要好好改善一下。

author: IGUser013
title: 视觉设计一直在线
content: The visual design is always on point! Clean, beautiful interface that puts photos front and center. 视觉效果一直是这个平台最吸引人的地方。Good for building a personal brand aesthetic. Great photo and video quality preservation.

author: IGUser014
title: 隐私设置经常失效
content: Privacy settings keep resetting! I set my account to private then it randomly becomes public. 我明明关闭了activity status但是别人还是能看到我什么时候在线。These privacy issues are unacceptable for a major social platform. 令人担忧！

author: IGUser015
title: 还行，能满足基本需求
content: 还行，勉强能满足我的基本需求吧。OK for sharing daily photos. 功能还算齐全，就是广告多了点。Not bad overall, normal social media experience. 希望以后能少一点广告。

author: IGUser016
title: Story加载经常失败
content: Story loading constantly fails! 点击story后一直转圈加载不出来。有时候加载出来没有声音。Video stories are especially problematic, they buffer forever. This story loading bug is so frustrating daily!

author: IGUser017
title: 和朋友互动很棒
content: Great way to interact with friends! Stories let me share my day and see what others are up to. 社交连接功能做得很好，通过互动贴纸能和朋友玩在一起。DM功能也很流畅，分享聊天很方便。

author: IGUser018
title: 广告质量差还多
content: Ads are everywhere and they're terrible quality! 同一个广告我一天看了20遍。广告内容和我兴趣完全不相关。Too many ads make the app feel cheap and annoying. 能不能让用户选择减少广告？

author: IGUser019
title: Reels看视频很好玩
content: Reels section is super entertaining! I can watch interesting short videos for hours. 发现了很多有趣的创作者和内容。The editing tools for creating Reels are easy to use and powerful. 很棒的功能！

author: IGUser020
title: 整体还行吧
content: 整体还行吧，说不上特别好也说不上差。Normal app with average features. 我每天都刷一会儿但是不会沉迷。Just your typical photo sharing social platform, 中规中矩的体验。

author: IGUser021
title: 算法推荐完全跑偏
content: Algorithm recommendations are completely off! I follow 50 artists and photographers but my feed shows zero of them. Instead the algorithm keeps pushing random viral trash. 算法推荐系统完全坏掉了，give us chronological feed back!

author: IGUser022
title: 滤镜和贴纸都很棒
content: The filters and stickers collection is fantastic! So many creative options for making unique content. 视觉效果真的很棒，我每次发照片都能调出喜欢的感觉。AR贴纸特别好玩，朋友互动性很强。

author: IGUser023
title: Story bug真的很多
content: So many story bugs! 我给story加的音乐经常不播放。Poll贴纸有时候显示不了结果。还有story观看列表不对，有些看了的人不在列表里。这些story bug已经持续几个月了还没修。

author: IGUser024
title: 记录生活的好工具
content: Wonderful tool for recording daily life! I love sharing my journey through photos and stories. 社交连接让我和远方的朋友保持联系。The visual quality and editing features are top notch for mobile photography enthusiasts.

author: IGUser025
title: 普普通通吧
content: 普普通通吧，该有的功能都有。Average social experience overall. 偶尔发现一些小bug但不影响使用。就是广告有点太多了，希望能改善。普通日常使用没问题。

author: IGUser026
title: 隐私问题严重
content: Serious privacy violations! My blocked accounts can still see my stories somehow. 我设置了仅粉丝可见但陌生人能浏览我的内容。还有location tag关不掉。These privacy bugs need immediate attention. 用户隐私太重要了。

author: IGUser027
title: Reels创意十足
content: Reels are so creative and fun! I've learned so many new things from watching Reels - cooking, crafts, travel tips. 算法有时候推荐内容还挺有意思的。Great entertainment value. The editing tools make it easy to create fun content too.

author: IGUser028
title: Story视频加载慢
content: Video stories take forever to load! I have good WiFi but 4K story videos buffer constantly. Story加载速度对比其他App慢很多。Sometimes the story won't load at all and I have to restart the app. 非常影响使用体验。

author: IGUser029
title: 视觉呈现很精美
content: Beautiful visual presentation throughout the app! Photo carousel looks elegant, stories are immersive. 视觉设计一直保持高水准。It really feels premium when sharing high quality content. Great for photographers and creators.

author: IGUser030
title: 还行，没什么特别
content: 还行，没什么特别的。OK application, nothing special. 能用，但也谈不上多喜欢。Average user experience with the usual social media problems. I check it daily out of habit more than enjoyment.

author: IGUser031
title: 算法推荐垃圾
content: The algorithm is garbage! It keeps showing me content from people I don't follow and have zero interest in. I never see posts from my actual friends anymore. 算法推荐需要彻底重做，现在完全没用！

author: IGUser032
title: 社交连接我的生活
content: This app connects my social life beautifully! I can keep up with all my friends through stories and posts. 社交功能做得很好，私信和群组功能都很实用。It's my favorite way to share moments and stay connected with my circle.

author: IGUser033
title: 广告和赞助内容太多
content: Ads and sponsored content everywhere now! Between posts, stories, reels, explore page - I can't escape ads. 广告占了我80%的feed内容。It's too much, I'm starting to hate opening the app. Please reduce广告密度！

author: IGUser034
title: 滤镜效果一流
content: First class filter effects! No other social app has such high quality filters consistently. 视觉效果真的是业界领先，每次用都很满意。Editing suite is easy to use yet powerful enough to create professional looking posts.

author: IGUser035
title: 凑合能用吧
content: 凑合能用吧，日常刷刷没问题。Normal social platform, average everything. 有一些小问题但也能接受。Not great, not terrible - it is what it is. 就是一个普通的图片分享应用。

author: IGUser036
title: Story有严重Bug
content: Critical story bug: 我发的story在我自己这能看到，但粉丝说看不到！连续三天了都是这个问题。I tried reposting, reinstalling, logging out - nothing fixes the story visibility bug. 严重影响工作！

author: IGUser037
title: Reels真的很有趣
content: Reels is genuinely fun! The short video format is addictive and I've discovered so many great creators. 创作工具也很顺手，加上音乐和特效很好玩。Social connection through shared trends and audio is brilliant concept.

author: IGUser038
title: 算法推荐毫无逻辑
content: Algorithm recommendations make no sense! 我点赞了旅行内容结果推荐一堆美妆视频。No logic to what appears on my explore page or reels. 算法还不如随机推荐呢。Give users the option to disable algorithmic suggestions.

author: IGUser039
title: 和朋友分享日常很好
content: Perfect for sharing daily moments with friends! Stories let me post quick updates without cluttering my feed. 社交连接做得很好，互动贴纸增加了趣味性。Overall great experience for keeping up with my loved ones visually.

author: IGUser040
title: 体验一般般
content: 体验一般般，不好不坏。Average experience really. 能满足基本的图片分享需求，但是惊喜不多。Normal social media app with the usual flaws and features. 中规中矩用着吧。

author: IGUser041
title: 隐私泄露风险
content: Privacy leakage risk is real! 我的账号明明是私密账号，但是陌生人可以保存我的照片。还有通讯录被自动读取了我都没授权。These privacy issues are extremely concerning and need to be fixed immediately. 隐私太令人担忧了。

author: IGUser042
title: 视觉体验一流
content: Top notch visual experience! The app is gorgeous to use. 照片展示效果非常精美，完全不压缩画质这点很棒。滤镜种类多质量高，视觉设计一直在进步。Love the clean aesthetic focusing on imagery.

author: IGUser043
title: 广告无处不在
content: Ads are literally everywhere! I can't scroll 2 posts without hitting an ad. Stories have ads between every 3 people. Reels is basically 50% ads now. 广告体验已经完全毁掉了这个App。I'm considering leaving.

author: IGUser044
title: 社交互动很棒
content: Wonderful social interaction experience! I love the sticker interactions on stories - polls, Q&A, quizzes make it fun. 社交连接功能完善，方便和朋友们保持日常互动。Great community features overall.

author: IGUser045
title: 整体表现普通
content: 整体表现普通，就是一个常规的社交平台。Not bad, average quality. 图片分享是核心功能还不错，其他新增功能就马马虎虎了。Normal day-to-day use is fine. 没什么值得特别表扬的地方。
